scenes.visual: A Korean office worker sees an enticing stock investment message on a smartphone, suspicious chat bubbles and rising stock chart around the phone.

scenes.narration: SNS와 메신저에서 투자 전문가나 증권사 관계자를 사칭해 접근합니다.
scenes.visual: A smartphone receiving social media and messenger invitations from a person posing as an investment expert, profile icon, chat bubbles and stock symbols.

scenes.narration: 높은 수익률과 다른 투자자의 성공 인증으로 신뢰를 쌓습니다.
scenes.visual: Fake profit screenshots, upward chart, coins and enthusiastic group-chat reactions surrounding a skeptical investor.

scenes.narration: 이후 특별 종목이나 비공개 정보를 강조하며 더 큰 입금을 요구합니다.
scenes.visual: An investment chat administrator points toward a VIP stock opportunity while arrows lead from a bank account to an investment app.

scenes.narration: 화면에는 수익이 계속 늘어나는 것처럼 표시됩니다.
scenes.visual: A fake trading dashboard showing rapidly increasing profits while the investor looks relieved, with subtle warning symbols behind the screen.

scenes.narration: 하지만 출금을 요청하면 세금, 보증금, 인증비 같은 추가 입금을 요구합니다.
scenes.visual: Investor presses a withdrawal button but a locked money icon appears, surrounded by tax, guarantee and verification fee symbols.

scenes.narration: 출금이 막힌 상태에서 추가 송금을 반복해서는 안 됩니다.
scenes.visual: A hand stops another bank transfer, large stop gesture between the investor and a suspicious investment platform.

scenes.narration: 피해가 의심된다면 지금 바로 법무법인 선린 사기피해 특화 전문 TF팀에 상담 받으세요.
scenes.visual: A worried investment victim consults a professional legal response team at a desk, documents and smartphone evidence organized clearly, reassuring professional atmosphere.
